bead.title: claude-tui/gate: capture /usage deltas for `claude --print` mode (3 runs)
bead.description:
PROBLEM: ADR-013's economic premise hinges on `claude --print` consuming API-metered request paths rather than the subscription window. No empirical /usage deltas have been captured for --print mode, so the API-metering claim is unverified.

ROOT CAUSE: docs/helix/02-design/billing-observation-claude-tui.md (created by sibling bead) has an empty '--print mode measurements' placeholder; no /usage snapshots exist for this mode.

PROPOSED FIX: Using the model, prompt, account, and refresh-delay defined in the methodology doc, run `claude --print` three times against the same authenticated account. For each run capture: /usage snapshot BEFORE, full turn output, /usage snapshot AFTER (taken at refresh-delay + safety margin, >=60s post-completion). Append all 6 /usage snapshots + 3 turn outputs to the '--print mode measurements' section of docs/helix/02-design/billing-observation-claude-tui.md. Record wall-clock timestamps for each snapshot.

NON-SCOPE: PTY+hooks measurements, delta computation, verdict determination, ADR-013 disposition, methodology authoring.

AC:
1) TestPrintModeHasThreeRuns: doc's --print section contains exactly 3 labeled runs.
2) TestPrintModeBeforeAfterSnapshots: each --print run has BEFORE and AFTER /usage snapshot blocks (6 total).
3) TestPrintModeTurnOutputsRecorded: each --print run has captured turn output.
4) TestPrintModeSnapshotTimestamps: every snapshot has a wall-clock timestamp.
5) TestPrintModeAfterRespectsRefreshDelay: each AFTER snapshot timestamp is >= completion-time + documented refresh-delay safety margin.
6) TestPrintModeSingleAccountAttested: doc attests no concurrent claude activity from same account during the --print window.

GATES: `go test ./...` passes; `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
bead.acceptance:
1) TestPrintModeHasThreeRuns
2) TestPrintModeBeforeAfterSnapshots
3) TestPrintModeTurnOutputsRecorded
4) TestPrintModeSnapshotTimestamps
5) TestPrintModeAfterRespectsRefreshDelay
6) TestPrintModeSingleAccountAttested
Gates: `go test ./...`, `lefthook run pre-commit`.
